criteria.criterion: CheckConfig in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs has an optional `paths` field (default: always run), and CheckSpec carries it through both capabilities' checks().
criteria.evidence: In the diff, config.rs adds `paths: Option<Vec<String>>` with serde default. capability.rs adds `CheckSpec.paths` and `applies_to`. athena-cap-change/src/lib.rs and athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs both pass `paths: k.paths.clone()` through.

criteria.criterion: athena.toml lists `paths` for the fmt, clippy and test checks of the change and study capabilities, so Rust, Cargo and toolchain files trigger them and docs-only changes do not.
criteria.evidence: All six checks have the same `paths` list: *.rs, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml, the rustfmt/clippy config files, .cargo/, crates/, xtask/, athena.toml and defaults.toml. Docs-only changes skip, as the criterion asks. However, the list leaves out studies/, which the tests read; this is reported as a finding.

criteria.criterion: The check loop in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs skips a check when no changed path matches, records it as passed with a 'not run' note, and runs every check when the change list is empty.
criteria.evidence: In run.rs (lines 630–695), the loop builds `change_list` from candidate.changes. When `!spec.applies_to(&change_list)` it pushes a CheckRun with passed: true, exit_code None and the note 'not run: no changed path can affect it'. `check_applies` returns true when the change list is empty.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: new tests pass showing a docs-only change list skips cargo checks, a .rs or Cargo.toml change runs them, and an unfiltered check always runs.
criteria.evidence: These tests pass: docs_only_changes_skip_filtered_checks, rust_and_cargo_changes_run_filtered_checks, unfiltered_checks_and_empty_changes_always_run, shipped_cargo_checks_are_filtered_to_rust_inputs and path_patterns_match_prefix_suffix_and_name. The full suite has 0 failures.

findings.summary: The shipped filter skips cargo test when only study records change, though tests read and check those records.
findings.evidence: The tests in rules.rs read studies/firstmate-work-handling/*.json through CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/../../studies and check every citation. No `paths` pattern matches studies/ or *.json, so check_applies returns false for a change that only touches studies/firstmate-work-handling/claims.json. The study capability gets the same filter, so a broken study record would be recorded as 'not run' and passed. The reading's assumptions were 'any non-.md path outside docs/ counts as affecting' and 'unknown path: run everything'.

findings.summary: No test exercises the skip inside the run loop.
findings.evidence: The new tests cover only applies_to/check_applies. No run-level test asserts that a docs-only job records the 'not run: no changed path can affect it' CheckRun. The 'tested' default in the brief asks for a test of the skip in the run loop.

findings.summary: The 13-entry pattern list is copied six times.
findings.evidence: Each of the six checks repeats the same `paths` array. A future fix has to be made in all six places, or the checks will drift apart.

request_reading_mismatch: The reading said the conservative default is to treat any non-.md path outside docs/ as affecting, and to run everything when a path is unknown. The candidate uses a fixed list of Rust inputs instead, so unlisted inputs that tests read (such as studies/*.json) skip the checks.
summary: The mechanism itself is correct and tested. CheckConfig/CheckSpec carry an optional `paths`, and the run loop skips a check when no changed path matches, records it as passed with a 'not run' note (the same shape as the nested-run skip), and runs everything when the change list is empty. fmt, clippy and the full test suite all pass when I run them. But the shipped filter is a fixed list of Rust inputs that leaves out files the tests read at run time. The athena-cap-study tests (`Loaded::read` in rules.rs) read studies/firstmate-work-handling/*.json and check every citation in them. A study job that edits those records would skip `cargo test` and be recorded as passed without those checks running. This breaks the reading's conservative assumptions ('any non-.md path outside docs/ counts as affecting'; 'unknown path: run everything') and lets broken study output land. Verdict: fail. Fix: add studies/ (and pinned-source/) to the filter, or skip only for .md paths outside crates/ as the reading said.
